parent_context:
4. The Criminal Information Support System (CISS) project is being developed to provide the
Puerto Rico Police (PRP) with countrywide access to a centralized data warehouse. The data
warehouse will be created from the databases of several police departments.
(a) Identify two differences between a data warehouse and a database. [2]
(b) Outline two advantages that the PRP will gain from using a data warehouse. [4]
(c) Describe how data in the CISS data warehouse could be updated in real time from the
police department databases. [4]
Data mining techniques are being used with the new PRP data warehouse to assist the
detection of patterns in crime data. Pattern detection approaches include cluster analysis
and classifications.
(d) Compare cluster analysis and classifications as pattern detection techniques. [5]
(e) Explain how link analysis could be used to detect patterns in crime data. [5]
End of Option A
